newsitem.title: USA: R.I. Economic Develop Corp head resigns.
newsitem.headline: R.I. Economic Develop Corp head resigns.

text.p: The executive director of the Rhode Island Economic Development Corporation Friday announced his resignation from the post.

Marcel Valois said in his resignation statement that "Public service is not my lifetime career. I never intended it to be so. I have worked hard with my staff and have made my mark in economic development for Rhode Island."
Valois has held the job as executive director for two-and-a-half years.
Valois thanked Rhode Island Gov. Lincoln Almond, the state Legislature and his staff for their efforts.
Through a spokeswoman, he told Reuters that he was exploring several opportunities in the private sector, but nothing was yet definite.
A spokesman for Almond was not immediately available.
